product_metadata.title: Christmas Tree Topper Lighted Star [Silver],3D Hollow Sparkling Star Christmas Tree Topper with Rotating Magic Cool White Snowflake Projector for Christmas Tree Ornament (Silver)
features: 【Christmas Tree Topper Star】Universal size for all kinds of different Christmas trees(9.8in(H) x 9.4in(L) x 1.8in(D)) , The 9.2ft plug wire is long enough to make the tree topper star easy to be connected. A nice glittery addition to your Christmas tree.

【Cool Snowflake Projector】The built-in magic ball LED projector decors your room with full of rotating patterns. You can adjust the distance and direction of the LED projection to project a different gorgeous effect. The farther from the ceiling, the larger the projection range.

【Sparkling Decorations】3D Star design with LED projector lamp inside. Covered with flashing powder which creates a magic and shining star for the top of Christmas tree. It also sparkles in the sun. Perfect for store, restaurant or small business, bar, hotel, shopping center, concert, etc.

【High Quality Material】This star Christmas tree topper is made of environmentally and premium PVC, and it's very durable and stable. It is packaged in a very beautiful box, which is suitable as a gift for your family, friends, colleagues.
【For you】If you have any problems with the product, please feel free to contact us for fast after-sale service. We will reply in 24 hours.
